_comment: Machine-readable evidence for the API coverage tables of docs/FEATURE_MATRIX.md (generated section) and docs/feature-matrix.html. Edit THIS file, then run python3 tools/gen_feature_matrix_html.py. cells: dev (device-tested), host (host tests only), aud (connected per static audit, no device test), no-op (vendor no-op, matched), cache, stub, err, miss (not exported), n.a. (not in that SoC's vendor API), ? (not determined), nob (no OpenIMP build for this SoC yet). better: SoCs where OpenIMP is better than the vendor (dev only). ref: evidence reference per SoC. used: streamers per SoC (p prudynt, r raptor, t timps; a dagger = source only, no binary checked). feature_links: a function cell 'aud' becomes 'dev' while the linked main-matrix feature cell is device-tested (supported).

Encoder_SetChnRcTrigLevel.note: T10/T20: SetChnRcTrigLevel is a controller input, not a stored value, and the call itself changes nothing in the running stream: the vendor keeps the pair and takes it over at the next natural IDR (i264e_idr_reconfig), where i264e_validate_parameters clamps it (level to an integer 2..10, new maximum QP from the application maximum to 51) and the controller is set up again; while a GOP uses more than level times its budget the controller lifts the QP cap from the application maximum to the new maximum (default 3.0 / 51). OpenIMP does the same (issue #194; before it restarted the controller at once with an extra IDR). Host oracle (tools/rc_t20_oracle.py --trig-wide and --trig-restart, vendor library under unicorn): 24 + 24 scenarios per SoC, 0 differences for T10 and T20. Camera 2026-11-03, vendor 3.12.0 and OpenIMP next via LD_LIBRARY_PATH (log markers checked, libalog preloaded, ISP day/night stable): a call at picture 40 now gives no extra IDR and no size burst (T20 28.6 kB against 38.3 kB vendor for 120 pictures, was 188 kB; T10 equal pictures 40 to 44 and IDR 60, QP 35 then 40 as the vendor); lift ceilings of a starved stream equal on T20 (36 / 36, was 48 against 37), within 1 to 3 QP on T10 (41-42 against 39-41). The T20 run without any call differs between the libraries (night scene, not the trigger). The 2026-11-02 runs used the installed libimp (OpenIMP) and are withdrawn. Sepia has worked since 2026-10-06 (beyond vendor, see `ISP_Tuning_Get/SetColorfxMode`); in the later imgfx run on a T21 camera B/W, sepia, negative, vivid, the CSC modes and the sinter/temper/DPC strengths changed the picture. Brightness, antifog and scene mode are vendor no-ops on T21 except that brightness now acts through the AE target (beyond vendor). ISP flip and `SetWB` auto gave a magenta picture in imgfx on T21 (timps' own flip path is fine): open, not a missing function; to be repeated in daylight.

**OSD, behaviour rather than a missing function:** on T21 the IPU blend is ineffective for about 2 s after a wake from idle; `claude/t21-osd-first-jpeg` (in agg-26) withholds JPEG frames without a confirmed overlay, so the first snapshot after a start now has the OSD (device-tested 2026-10-05, first snapshot about 2 s later).
